kept.name: TestArchiveRunDir
kept.reason: pins that the run dir moves whole to a stamped sibling and is recreated empty, the numeric collision suffix, and that an absent run dir is an error

kept.name: TestArchiveStaleOutputs
kept.reason: pins the stamped archive name, the numeric collision suffix and that an absent entry in the list is skipped, none of which the callers' tests assert

kept.name: TestBouncer_Amendment
kept.reason: pins the new generation a changed subject starts: its archive and records, the allowance and hard cap, the note a seed reads, and the paths that degrade or return an error

kept.name: TestBouncer_BlockingNeverCallsApproveOrCommit
kept.reason: pins that a CONTINUE verdict calls neither the Approve nor the Commit seam

kept.name: TestBouncer_Cancellation_ParsedVerdictSurvives
kept.reason: pins that a verdict the judge wrote survives a cancellation during the run, for both an approving and a blocking verdict

kept.name: TestBouncer_Circling_NoDecisionAwaitsNamingBothVerbs
kept.reason: pins the awaiting reason a circling round with no decision writes: both verbs, each with the slug argument or without it

kept.name: TestBouncer_Circling_RecordedDecision
kept.reason: pins settling a decision recorded on a CIRCLING round that never wrote an escalation record, which the escalation tests never reach

kept.name: TestBouncer_Clear_AfterCommitFailureSubsequentCallClears
kept.reason: pins the commit-failure then re-entry sequence: the failed commit leaves the directory CONVERGED and the next Call clears it instead of retrying the commit

kept.name: TestBouncer_Clear_ApprovedRunDirClearsAndReseeds
kept.reason: pins that the whole approved generation moves to one archived sibling, the recreated run dir holds only the seed's focus file, the log line and the collision suffix

kept.name: TestBouncer_Clear_EndToEndSequence
kept.reason: pins the whole seed, judge, approve and re-entry sequence on one Bouncer value across calls, which no single-call test chains

kept.name: TestBouncer_Clear_NonTriggeringCasesLeaveRunDirUntouched
kept.reason: pins that none of the non-triggering states archives the run dir, which the outcome assertions of the tests that reach them do not check

kept.name: TestBouncer_ClusterExcludesReachesSeedAndJudgePrompts
kept.reason: pins that the exclude_lenses example line and rule reach the seed and judge prompts exactly when ClusterExcludes is set, and that the WebsterRecord and RedundancyReport notes reach the rubric in both

kept.name: TestBouncer_Commit_CancelledContextStillCommits
kept.reason: pins that an already-cancelled context still commits an approved verdict, which no Call-driven test can reach

kept.name: TestBouncer_ConvergedSettle_CallsApproveThenCommit
kept.reason: pins that each non-nil seam runs exactly once, Approve strictly before Commit, and that a nil seam is not an error

kept.name: TestBouncer_DecisionEscalation
kept.reason: pins the decision cause's routing, snapshot, refusal and carry-over contract across the verdicts, the budget and the hard cap, which no other test reaches

kept.name: TestBouncer_EntryProbe_AttachedJudgeSettlesInsteadOfClearingOrReplaying
kept.reason: pins that a live judge behind an already-written verdict is attached to before the clear or replay branch acts, and its own output is neither archived nor overwritten

kept.name: TestBouncer_EntryProbe_SpecNamesTheJudgesOwnOutputFiles
kept.reason: pins the OutputFiles set the judge's entry probe names, which no other test reads off the recorded attach spec

kept.name: TestBouncer_Escalation_AwaitsWithTheRecordAndLeavesItUntouched
kept.reason: pins the escalation's Awaiting pointer and reason, the record and notice it writes, the cause it picks, the accept-only offer at the hard cap and that a re-call leaves the record untouched

kept.name: TestBouncer_Escalation_RecordedDecision
kept.reason: pins how a recorded decision settles an escalation of any cause: continue is exempt from the budget for a budget cause or at a spent budget, re-escalates at the hard cap, and accept approves, commits and clears

kept.name: TestBouncer_FocusSynthesis_OverUnparseableFile
kept.reason: pins that an unparseable focus file is archived byte-identical and replaced by a well-formed empty one, on both the replay and the seed path

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgeCall_AttachesToLiveJudgeInsteadOfRespawning
kept.reason: pins that the judge pass attaches to a live judge without archiving its declared outputs out from under it

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgeCall_DebrisIsNotJudged
kept.reason: pins that stale or half-written judge outputs are archived byte-identical before the spawn and never mistaken for a judged round

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgeCall_Harvest
kept.reason: pins that the harvest is keyed on judged(N): a written verdict settles the round whatever the run reported, and a non-completion with nothing written degrades

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgeCall_PromptReadsFactsNotArtifacts
kept.reason: pins the judge prompt's inputs: the facts and review paths, never the artifacts or the fixer report, and the Go-built parse-error decision-rule sentence

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgeCall_Verdicts
kept.reason: pins the judge call's outcome and ledger pointer per verdict, the three declared outputs and the well-formed empty next-round focus file

kept.name: TestBouncer_JudgePromptOffersCirclingOnlyFromTheCheckpoint
kept.reason: pins that the checkpoint round configured on the Bouncer reaches the judge prompt's decision rule

kept.name: TestBouncer_Reentry
kept.reason: pins the settle record's writes and the re-entry cases over a settled verdict, whose spawn-free and clearing paths no other test reaches

kept.name: TestBouncer_Replay_Blocking
kept.reason: pins the replay's warning log and that the verdict and ledger are left byte-identical, which the tests that reach a replay do not check

kept.name: TestBouncer_SeedCall_HappyPath
kept.reason: pins the seed call's spec, pointer and focus file, and that it writes no verdict or ledger

kept.name: TestBouncer_SeedDiscriminator_ParsesRatherThanStats
kept.reason: pins that a present but unparseable focus file is archived and re-seeded rather than treated as a re-bounce

kept.name: TestBouncer_SeedSideHarvest_SurvivesALateFailure
kept.reason: pins that a focus file the seed agent wrote survives a late run error or a non-Done outcome byte-identical

kept.name: TestBouncer_Verdict_CirclingReturnsAwaitingAndReplaysWithoutSpawning
kept.reason: pins that a CIRCLING verdict returns Awaiting naming the round and cause, and that a fresh Bouncer over the same run dir replays it without spawning

kept.name: TestBouncer_Verdict_CirclingWithLiveJudgeAttachesAndHarvests
kept.reason: pins that a CIRCLING verdict with a live judge attaches to it, never respawns, and keeps the judge's own next-round focus file

kept.name: TestBouncer_Verdict_LegacyWordAtEntry
kept.reason: pins how a legacy verdict word on disk at Call entry is read: APPROVED clears and re-seeds, BLOCKING replays as a Stuck over the ledger

kept.name: TestComputeRoundFacts_GatingRule
kept.reason: pins the gating rule of the round facts: MEDIUM design findings are gating, a BLOCKING scope finding is counted but not gating

kept.name: TestDecisionRuleMarker_CirclingOnlyFromTheCheckpoint
kept.reason: pins the decision rule's text: both non-circling verdicts are always offered, the rising-count caveat comes with CIRCLING, and round 2 on renders the lighter rule with its earlier-open list and round-1 fallback

kept.name: TestEntryErrAndCancelErr
kept.reason: pins that the entry and cancel errors name the producer and engine, wrap the context error and read differently

kept.name: TestEscalation_AbsentRecord
kept.reason: pins that an absent escalation record reads as absent with no error

kept.name: TestEscalation_RoundTrip
kept.reason: pins the escalation record's round trip: cause, notice, brief body, an empty brief, and no notice file for an empty notice

kept.name: TestFactsPath_IsNotAJudgeOutput
kept.reason: pins the facts file's name and that it is an input the judge reads, not an output a stale-output archive would move

kept.name: TestGateFailedReason_NamesAttemptsAndFindingsPath
kept.reason: pins that the attempt count and the findings path are both interpolated into the gate-failed reason

kept.name: TestHarvestedVerdict_RefusesLegacyWords
kept.reason: pins the function-level split on a legacy word: the harvest refuses it while the recorded read aliases it

kept.name: TestNewBouncer_AcceptedConfigs
kept.reason: pins the config shapes NewBouncer accepts: empty seed and judge pairs, a nil clock that defaults, and an artifact path that does not exist yet

kept.name: TestParseFocusSpecific
kept.reason: pins the focus frontmatter's accept and reject rows (round bounds, scalar focus, absent exclude_lenses), which the bouncer tests reach only through well-formed files

kept.name: TestParseProseAndUnknownKey
kept.reason: pins that each file contract tolerates an unknown frontmatter key and normalises CRLF prose to LF

kept.name: TestReadRoundFocus_DirectivePathOnlyWhenTheFileSaysSomething
kept.reason: pins the focus reader against the file the writer produces: the directive path only when the file says something, the exclude lenses, and the target round's filename

kept.name: TestReadRubric
kept.reason: pins the rubric fill and strip: both markers substituted, the stamp banner removed, a markerless rubric unchanged, the redundancy report read only for its marker, and the errors for an empty specs dir or an unreadable rubric

kept.name: TestReadRubric_EmptyStencilsDirIsAnError
kept.reason: pins that an empty stencils dir is an error naming stencils_dir, which needs the cwd changed and so cannot join the parallel table

kept.name: TestRecordCirclingDecision_WritesPendingFile
kept.reason: pins the decision file RecordCirclingDecision writes per decision, escalation record and cause, and its round and cause return values

kept.name: TestRenderFocus_RoundTripsThroughParseFocus
kept.reason: pins the render and parse round trip for shapes the bouncer tests never write: nil lists, YAML metacharacters in a lens name, and prose

kept.name: TestResolveRound
kept.reason: pins the round scan: the highest present round, zero for an empty run dir, and that a gap stops the scan

kept.name: TestRoundPathHelpers_PinExactFilenameSpellings
kept.reason: pins the on-disk filename spellings the producers and stencils name, which no behavior test asserts byte for byte

kept.name: TestWebsterProducer_OutcomeDone
kept.reason: pins that a done run returns the summary as pointer carrying its gate count and spans, is never asked for a fresh start, and survives a cancellation during the run

kept.name: TestWebsterProducer_PendingAuditFindingsIsStuck
kept.reason: pins the pending-audit refusal's reason, which is the refusal's own text, and the re-entry step the run is handed

kept.name: TestWriteRoundFacts_IsDeterministic
kept.reason: pins that two writes of the facts file are byte-identical and the no-recurring-key line, which the judge-call tests do not assert
